preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership through some means)
Contract must have a non-zero ETH balance (from accumulated fees or direct transfers)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call withdrawStuckETH() when the contract has ETH balance. The function uses a low-level call without checking the return value, so even if the transfer fails (e.g., recipient is a contract that reverts), the ETH will remain locked in the contract. However, if the transfer succeeds, the attacker gains the ETH. Alternatively, set operationsAddress to a malicious contract that reverts on receive, causing ETH to accumulate in the contract, then later change operationsAddress to attacker's address and trigger swapBack() to capture accumulated funds.
